name: What should be included in a kitchen cabinet installation estimate?

mainEntity.name: What should be included in a kitchen cabinet installation estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check whether the estimate covers only hanging the boxes or includes complete finish carpentry. A comprehensive quote should state whether it covers removing old cabinetry, leveling subfloors, installing base and wall units, and securing toe kicks. It should also specify decorative trim details, such as crown molding, light valances, filler strips, and hardware installation for knobs and pulls. Clarify if the contractor manages necessary framing adjustments and sub-trade coordination, such as plumbing disconnects and electrical rough-ins for under-cabinet lights.
acceptedAnswer.description: An estimate should detail cabinet hanging, shimming, trim work like crown molding and toe kicks, hardware mounting, and any necessary framing prep.
